input: Repot the overgrown peace lily on the windowsill

gold.taskTitle: Repot the overgrown peace lily on windowsill
gold.taskDescription: Repot the overgrown peace lily currently sitting on the windowsill into a larger or more suitable container.

questions.title: How much larger is the new pot than the current one?
questions.description: Understand the target pot size relative to the current one to guide purchasing or selection.

questions.title: Do you already have a new pot and fresh soil?
questions.description: Determine whether supplies need to be purchased before the task can begin.

questions.title: What type of potting mix do you plan to use?
questions.description: Identify whether the user has a specific soil type in mind, such as a general mix or one formulated for tropical plants.

questions.title: Are you planning to divide the plant while repotting?
questions.description: Find out if the user wants to separate offshoots or keep the plant as a single specimen.

questions.title: Is there a specific date or deadline to get this done?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure or preferred timing for completing the repot.

questions.title: Where will you be doing the repotting work?
questions.description: Clarify the workspace so prep steps like laying down sheets or moving to a sink can be planned.

questions.title: Has the plant shown any signs of pests or root rot?
questions.description: Determine if the repotting involves any treatment steps beyond a straightforward size upgrade.
